summary: Conecuh County, AL tower built in 1942 by African-American CCC Camp P-76; NHLR-registered 2010 as US 862. Current condition and public access not confirmed.

notes_for_editor: Build year (1942) and the CCC Camp P-76 attribution agree across the NHLR entry and Jackson's Ramblings. Registry number conflict: NHLR says US 862, AL 40; Jackson's Ramblings says US 862, Al 41. The story reports both and does not pick one; NHLR is the register of record, so check it before any correction. Jackson's spells the town Bellville, while the register and record use Belleville. Facebook and YouTube posts seen in search were not used (one calls the county Connecticut County). The drone videos are the only sign of a recent visit or sighting, and they carry no condition or access statement. No staffing or fire source found. The Forest Lookouts Alabama list in the local cache (eastern_us_lookouts/lee.html navigation) does not include Belleville, Beauregard or Blackjack; treat that as a snapshot, not a verdict. Used 2 WebSearch calls and about 5 page reads.
